title: Deposited Firebrand Consumption
summary: Verifies decay of the active deposited-firebrand population by paired consumption-on/off runs and a four-resolution convergence study.
expected: At 260 s the consumption-on active firebrand population should be at most 4% of the paired no-consumption population, consistent with the reference observation that more than 96% is consumed. Consumption must not materially change surface-fire TOA, active counts must remain nonnegative, and profiles should converge toward the 1 m result.
